objective: Map conversation notes into pain, objective, objections, decision criteria, top moves, and exception readiness without changing lane authority.

confidenceRules.high: Conversation notes provide enough detail to drive a live story.
confidenceRules.medium: Notes are usable but may need consultant confirmation.
confidenceRules.low: Notes are thin and IDB must ask for more context.
confidenceRules.none: No notes captured; use lane fallback and ask for the SC request pain.
